summary: The source limits m and n to ten and k to four, leaving only 400 legal input tuples and at most 100 output cells, so meaningful asymptotic runtime tiers cannot be formed.

replacement_checks.evidence: The remotely accepted implementation initializes exactly m*n cells, edits a constant-size path block and at most m+n corridor positions, and joins exactly m rows of length n.

The certificate regression executes both packaged sources for all 400 legal (m, n, k) tuples, validates shape and alphabet, counts paths with an independent dynamic program, and checks impossibility against the obstacle-free binomial maximum.
